_comment: CA003 - Phishing-resistant MFA for privileged roles. Applies to: the Halden Microsoft Entra ID tenant (P2, lab only). Admin accounts are cloud-only (never synced) and must satisfy a phishing-resistant authentication strength. The id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004 is Microsoft's built-in 'Phishing-resistant MFA' authentication-strength policy, a public constant, not a tenant value. The token __ADMIN_ROLE_IDS__ is replaced at deploy time with the role template ids resolved from configs/privileged-roles.json, so no role ids are invented or hard-coded here. Deployed by 07-New-ConditionalAccessPolicies.ps1, report-only first.
